import asyncio
from unittest.mock import Mock
from aiohttp.http_parser import HttpRequestParserPy
from aiohttp.http_exceptions import BadHttpMessage, BadStatusLine
cases = [
    (f"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n{chr(255)}oo: bar\r\n\r\n".encode(), BadHttpMessage),
    (b"GET\n/path\x0cHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", BadStatusLine),
]
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
try:
    for raw, expected in cases:
        parser = HttpRequestParserPy(Mock(), loop, 2**16)
        try:
            parser.feed_data(raw)
        except expected:
            print(expected.__name__, "rejected as expected")
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"expected {expected.__name__}: {raw!r}")
finally:
    loop.close()
